The '''Gendius sector''' was a sector located in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that bordered [[Elbaran sector/Legends|Elbaran]], [[Iska sector/Legends|Iska]], [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan]] and [[Bruanii sector/Legends|Bruanii sectors]] in the Mid Rim, and [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
